title: The Premium Presented on a Pass and Trip Protection Plan
content:
The premium presented on a Pass and Trip Protection plan is one instalment of premium for each presentation
that has fallen due on the covered holding's schedule and has not yet been raised on the plan, and it is never
below zero.

**The premium still to be collected.** The premium still to be collected on a plan is the balance the plan's
own record carries.

**The instalments still to fall.** The instalments still to fall on the covered holding's schedule are one.

**One instalment of premium.** One instalment of premium is the premium still to be collected divided equally
over the whole months from the day cover began to the day cover is due to end, rounded to the cent.

**The number presented.** One instalment is presented.

**The amount presented.** The amount presented is the amount of one instalment multiplied by the number of
instalments presented, each instalment having been rounded to the cent before that multiplication and the
product taken as it stands with no adjustment for what the rounding of a single instalment leaves over.

**Plans nothing is presented on.** A premium is presented only on a plan the collective still collects premium
on, and a plan carrying no premium still to be collected has nothing presented on it.

**Worked example (hypothetical inputs).** Take a plan whose record carries a balance still to be collected of
195.00 USD, cover having begun and being due to end 5 whole months apart. One instalment of premium is 195.00
USD divided equally over 5 months, which is 39.00 USD. One instalment is presented, so the amount presented is
39.00 USD taken once, which is 39.00 USD.

**A second example, showing the rounding (hypothetical inputs).** Take a plan whose record carries a balance
still to be collected of 100.00 USD over 3 whole months. One instalment is 33.33 USD once rounded to the cent.
One instalment is presented, so the amount presented is 33.33 USD, and the cent the rounding leaves over is
not added back.

**A plan with nothing outstanding (hypothetical inputs).** A plan whose record carries a balance still to be
collected of nothing has 0.00 USD presented on it.
